name: Gap-down reversal: call when price climbs back above the first 5-minute candle's close
why: Mandeep, 13 Nov 2026 (Nifty and Bank Nifty bounced from 09:20 after a gap-down). Index pre-test 2022-2026 (research 0003): Bank Nifty 11 of 16 days hit +0.4% before -0.3% when back above the first candle's close by 09:30; Nifty 5 of 14. Small sample, 3 versions looked at: not proven.
